project.description: The file-type families as signed distance fields, in an atlas of their own: the eight sheets every file icon is cut from and each family's emblem, baked from vexelray-icons (committed, as the icon atlas is), and the FileSheet and FileFamily enums that name them. Apart from vexelray-gui-icons because only a file browser draws them, and one that does wants the whole set. Rebaked by vexelray-icons/tools/Bake.java when the art changes.
